root_idea.summary: The root centers on spreading, flattening, and preparing something as an extended surface or support.
root_idea.development: From spreading and making a surface usable come meanings for bedding, level ground, low-spreading growth, wings extended near the ground, and several figurative or specialized applications. Some lexical branches, such as insects, livestock, and anatomical terms, are conventional extensions or specialized usages.

senses.definition: To spread or expand something into an extended surface; in the Quran, to spread out the earth.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is the perfect Form I verb with the earth as object.

senses.definition: Flying insects, especially moths, that flutter or fall toward a flame; scattered moths are used as the Quranic image.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form occurs in the comparison كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ, describing scattered, confused movement.

senses.definition: Small or young livestock, or animals designated for riding or slaughter; the Quranic usage concerns the livestock category called فَرْش.
senses.usage_conditions: Classical interpretation varies over whether the term specifically denotes young camels or extends to cattle, sheep, and goats, especially animals fit for slaughter. It may function as a collective or as a singular-looking noun.

senses.definition: A spread-out surface or furnishing for resting: a bed, couch, or comparable support; in the Quran, the earth is made a level, usable resting surface and heavenly furnishings are described as couches.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural فُرُشٌ is used for couches or beds. In the earth construction, the term emphasizes suitability for settling rather than a literal manufactured bed.

senses.definition: Spouses or wives, by metonymic extension from the bed; this is an alternative interpretation of the Quranic plural فُرُشٌ in the passage about elevated furnishings.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an exegetical Quranic interpretation reported for the supplied Quranic form, distinct from the physical bed or couch sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread or lay out a bed, carpet, garment, cloth, dust, or other material for someone or beneath someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may mean spreading something for another person or laying it out for oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread or lay the forelegs or forearms flat upon the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a lion, wolf, dog, or other beast of prey, and also of a person; the phrase can describe the posture of placing the forearms on the ground in prostration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desirable slight outward spread or non-erect shape of the hind leg of a camel or horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Excessive spreading, in which the hock joints strike together, is distinguished as عَقَلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disperse or spread abroad young camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This usage is explained by the synonym بَثَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a person's state or affair ample, open, or free from constraint; to lay it fully before someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a state, case, or affair, and the construction is figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lay oneself out in service of others or make oneself available as a sacrifice for them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is figurative and can describe exceptional kindness or self-subordination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw someone down, overcome him, and get upon him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension of making someone or something a surface to be trodden upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread or pave a place, including a house, with carpets, baked bricks, broad stones, or similar material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The house-paving usage is also expressed with the Form II verbal noun تَفْرِيشٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire and prepare oneself for a person or matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This reported construction is distinct from the ordinary transitive sense of spreading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie or tell falsehoods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is illustrated by the question كَمْ تَفْرُشُ, “How long will you lie?”

other_classical_meanings.definition: For seed-produce to spread itself over the surface of the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Form II intransitive or reflexive-like use concerning shoots or seed growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a bird to expand and flap its wings over something without alighting; for a young locust to spread its wings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is a bird or young locust, and the movement is an extension of the wings rather than settling on the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak evil of someone or slander him, including in his absence, and figuratively to attack his honour by speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction أَفْرَشَ فِي عِرْضِهِ specifically takes a person's honour as the object of verbal attack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a sword thin, or thin and fine at its edge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized figurative or technical application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For trees to put forth branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is given as synonymous with أَغْصَنَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave, quit, or desist from someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe a person ceasing an attack or death withdrawing from people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a mare to desire to be covered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized usage said of a female horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone young camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The young camels may be small or large according to the cited explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become the possessor of young camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is reported with some uncertainty about the vocalization or verb form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a place to abound in moths, butterflies, or the seed-produce associated with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is said of a place and describes the abundance found there, not the insect or plant itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a lock fast by means of its catch or catches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage occurs in the paired expression “he locked, and made fast by the lock catches.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak in whatever manner one wishes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Literally, the tongue is expanded; the expression is figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tread upon someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is figuratively made into a carpet or bed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or travel along a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The road is conceived as a surface spread beneath the traveler.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach sexually or have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence supports the construction but does not require a restriction on the object's gender, status, or number.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a woman as a wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional marital extension of the sexual or bed metaphor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sky to assail or overtake people with rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The rain is figuratively spread over or brought down upon the people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take property, livestock, or wealth wrongfully or by force.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be مال in the broad sense of property or cattle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow someone's footsteps or track him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is figurative and refers to following a laid-out trace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become spread or expanded, as a garment or similar thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be used in an active or passive-like construction according to the cited grammatical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What is spread as household furniture, such as carpets, mattresses, and similar furnishings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Here فَرْشٌ is used as a substantive passive participle as well as an infinitive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seed-produce after it has spread over the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some descriptions specify the stage at which the plant has become three- or four-leaved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place abounding in plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative place-name extension from vegetation spread over the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wide, level, soft, unobstructed plain or tract of land, including a depressed wooded tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote open even ground or a particular low tract containing specified trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collection or round plot of trees, including certain thorn-tree groves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized landscape term is distinct from the broader meaning of an open plain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shrubs or small trees, and small firewood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer either to the living growth or to its use as small fuel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized expression distinct from the Quran-attested livestock interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A somewhat depressed, extended track in wide, level country, sometimes measuring a day's and night's journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is used for a broad desert track rather than ordinary level ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Form, appearance, or garb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is synonymous with هَيْئَةٌ in the cited expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of household furnishings such as carpets and mattresses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an occupational derivative of فَرْشٌ in the furniture sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Young locusts after their wings develop and spread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is one Classical identification of فَرَاشٌ in addition to moths and similar flying insects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Certain emerging or winged insects, including insects compared with moths and, by one explanation, silkworms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized lexical identifications and are not required by the Quranic moth comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A light-headed, light-witted, unsteady, or contemptible person, by comparison with a moth's flight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The human description is figurative and evaluative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thin bones, bone fragments, or bony plates of the head, including structures near the bone covering the brain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may include thin pieces that fly off when the head is struck and other thin cranial structures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where the upper ends of the ribs are joined to the spine of the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an anatomical expression, not the general insect or bedding noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two extremities of the haunches near the relevant depression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dual form names a paired anatomical structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper portions of the shoulder blades that rise toward the base of the neck and level back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized anatomical plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two colored veins beneath the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited usage is a dual anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two iron pieces or catches that fasten the cheek straps of a bridle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression belongs to horse tack and harness terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The edge of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a narrowly reported lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mud that has dried on the ground after the water has receded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also be related to the residue left after flowing water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A little water remaining in pools left by torrents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The clear ground beneath the remnant water may be visible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small bubbles on the surface of a beverage or water, or a small quantity of sweat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage concerns surface bubbles or a slight film of moisture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The catches, teeth, or small pins of a lock that enter corresponding holes and hold it fast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term denotes the mechanism of the lock, not the act of fastening it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spouse by metonymy: a wife, or in the expression الولد للفراش, the husband or master of the bed who has the relevant marital claim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical usage includes the legal or idiomatic bed metaphor and is distinct from the Quranic exegetical interpretation listed under the public form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird's nest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension from a spread or resting place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A house or tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is an assumed figurative extension from a dwelling or resting place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The innermost place reached by the tongue in the mouth, including the skin covering the bases of the upper teeth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact anatomical location is described with some variation in the cited authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant or herbage that spreads over the ground rather than standing on a stem.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participial form describes low, ground-spreading growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl or young woman who has been sexually approached or compressed by a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized participial usage attributed to the Form VIII construction and is reported on limited authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An Arabian bull without a hump, or a specified kind of oxen with small humps and flaccid dewlaps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The zoological descriptions vary among the cited explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mare or other solid-hoofed animal shortly after giving birth, especially about seven days afterward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term marks a period considered suitable for placing a burden on the animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small quantity of water, especially water remaining in a vessel or in a clear pool left by a torrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the remnant itself or a smooth place where such water collects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large foundation stones, like millstones, laid first beneath a palm enclosure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a construction term for the base stones of the enclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Two cartilages near the uvula or the neighboring arches of the soft palate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dual form names a paired anatomical structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who spreads, arranges, and maintains carpets, beds, mattresses, or similar furnishings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This occupational noun is reported as probably post-Classical in formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A padded or quilt-like article placed on a saddle or saddle covering for someone to sit upon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: مِفْرَشَةٌ is described as a smaller version used on the camel saddle or its saddle covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Women or wives, by extension from furnishings or beds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural occurs in expressions about a man's high-born wives or women.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose life has passed away wasted because he never married; related expressions describe people destined not to die in their beds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning belongs to fixed idiomatic expressions, not to the ordinary saddle-pad noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel having no hump; the same participial pattern can describe a flat-topped hill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel and hill applications are distinct conventional uses of the participial form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flat-topped hill or eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The hill is described as spread or flattened at its top.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seed-produce spreading itself over the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This active participle describes the spreading growth of the seed-produce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A head wound reaching the thin cranial bones, or cracking the bone without crushing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact degree of bone injury varies in the cited explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel whose hind leg has the condition called فَرْشٌ, or a specified bending of that leg.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an anatomical or conformation description of a camel's leg.

lane_unit_coverage.note: A roomy bed is an application of the bedding sense.

cautions: The Form I Quranic verb is normalized from the inflected QAC lemma فَرَشْ to the dictionary citation form فَرَشَ.
Interpretations of Quranic فَرْشٌ in 6:142 vary between young or small livestock and animals fit for slaughter; the entry preserves the supported range without treating one interpretation as certain.
The spouse interpretation of فُرُشٌ is explicitly reported as an alternative Quranic interpretation; the supplied contextual glosses identify the physical couch sense.
Lane's Quran references use historical citation conventions. The modern verse locations used here are only the independently supplied QAC locations.
